title: Enterprise model admission scorecard and safe pin migration procedure
creator: Aisha Ramos
description: Problem: Enterprise customers frequently request new model variants, version pins, and delayed deprecations. Without a deterministic triage and migration procedure, we face inconsistent SLAs, surprise regressions, and high support overhead. Goal: Deliver a repeatable admission scorecard and an operational pinning+migration procedure that balances customer needs, runtime economics, and catalog stability. This ticket contains the scorecard (quantitative weights), required eval gates, a recommended canary and migration timeline, communication templates, and runbook handoffs for Engineering and Customer Success.
acceptance_criteria: A documented scorecard with numeric weights that the PM and SRE/Runtime teams agree on
A checklist of automated and manual eval gates that must pass before a model is approved for enterprise pinning
An approved pin migration procedure with canary parameters and rollback criteria
Communication templates for customer notifications and internal rollout notes
A linked Confluence doc and a GH issue/PR for any runtime changes required
rubric: Scorecard (0-100) composed of weighted categories: Security & Compliance (30) - GDPR/data residency, licensed model provenance, KMS/HSM compatibility; Quality & Semantic Stability (25) - eval regression delta on golden prompts, hallucination metrics, hallucination severity; Runtime Economics (20) - per-token cost delta, memory/latency delta, quantization compatibility; Enterprise Demand & Strategic Fit (15) - number of paid customers requesting, revenue risk, vertical compliance needs; Maintenance & Ecosystem Risk (10) - footprint for infra, special ops, expected maintenance cadence. Use thresholds: Accept if total >= 70; Conditional Accept (soft pin) if 60-69 with mitigations; Reject if < 60. Each category must be justified in the admission ticket.
flow_steps: 1) Intake: PM creates catalog admission request with model metadata, customer use-cases, and target pin window (Confluence + Linear ticket)
2) Quick triage (24-48h): PM assigns SRE/Runtime, Security reviewer, and Research owner for an initial scorecard draft
3) Automated evals: Run golden prompt suite, safety checks, latency/cost benching. Capture delta vs baseline model.
4) Manual review (72h): Security and Research review artifacts; determine whether additional tests or contract reviews are needed
5) Decision: Approve / Conditional (soft pin) / Reject. If Approve -> schedule pin date and rollout plan. If Conditional -> list mitgations and re-eval window (2 weeks).
6) Migration: Execute canary (5% traffic) for 48h, escalate metrics; increase to 25% for 24h if stable, then full migration per schedule
7) Post-migration audit: 7-day watch with SLO/QA checks and customer success verification. If any regression exceeds thresholds -> automatic rollback to previous pinned model
